metadata.title: Genshin Gem Wish - Demo Exploration Markers
metadata.description: Curated realistic dataset for Mondstadt and Liyue exploration with surface and underground layers

layers.name: Teyvat Surface
layers.description: Standard overworld terrain across all Teyvat nations

layers.name: Underground / Caverns
layers.description: Subterranean caves, ruins, and underground mines (e.g. Dragonspine Caverns, Chasm Underground)

markers.name: Statue of The Seven - Windrise
markers.description: Underneath the massive oak tree in Windrise.

markers.name: Waypoint - Starfell Lake
markers.description: On the small bluff overlooking Starfell Lake.

markers.name: Waypoint - Mondstadt Plaza
markers.description: Near the central fountain plaza in Mondstadt City.

markers.name: Anemoculus - Windrise Tree Branch
markers.description: High up on the southern branch of the great tree at Windrise.

markers.name: Anemoculus - Starfell Lake Pillar
markers.description: Above the floating anemo monument, glide from statue bluff.

markers.name: Anemoculus - Whispering Woods Cliff
markers.description: Floating off the cliff edge near the Whispering Woods beach.

markers.name: Anemoculus - Mondstadt Cathedral Spire
markers.description: At the very peak cross of the Favonius Cathedral spire.

markers.name: Anemoculus - Cider Lake Island
markers.description: Activate the anemo wind current on the northwest islet.

markers.name: Luxurious Chest - Cathedral Bell Tower
markers.description: Inside the open belfry directly beneath the cathedral roof.

markers.name: Luxurious Chest - Knights of Favonius Tower
markers.description: Guarded on the parapet walkway above HQ library.

markers.name: Precious Chest - Stormbearer Point Eye of the Storm
markers.description: Defeat the Eye of the Storm near the northern sun dial cliff.

markers.name: Exquisite Chest - Windrise Hilichurl Camp
markers.description: Clear the Mitachurl outpost northeast of Windrise tree.

markers.name: Common Chest - Whispering Woods Barrel
markers.description: Tucked behind three wooden barrels along the dirt path.

markers.name: Shrine of Depths - Windwail Highland
markers.description: High on the ridge overlooking Dawn Winery.

markers.name: Seelie - Starfell Valley Stream
markers.description: Follow the Seelie downstream into its seelie garden court.

markers.name: Dandelion Seed - Mondstadt City Gates
markers.description: Outside city entrance along outer defensive stone walls.

markers.name: Dandelion Seed - Starsnatch Cliff Ridge
markers.description: Group of 3 dandelions blowing in the wind near cliff peak.

markers.name: Waypoint - Snow-Covered Path
markers.description: Entrance to Dragonspine just past the adventurer research camp.

markers.name: Precious Chest - Starglow Cavern Lower Ice Pond
markers.description: Complete the timed freezing combat challenge inside the cavern.

markers.name: Seelie - Starglow Cavern Warming Seelie
markers.description: Fire Seelie warming the lower tunnel path.

markers.name: Statue of The Seven - Dihua Marsh
markers.description: Overlooking Dihua Marsh near the Wangshu Inn northern bridge.

markers.name: Waypoint - Liyue Harbor Northern Entrance
markers.description: On the wooden pavilion overlooking the entry bridge.

markers.name: Waypoint - Wangshu Inn Top Floor
markers.description: Beside the reception desk at the top of Wangshu Inn.

markers.name: Waypoint - Jueyun Karst Peak
markers.description: High mountain peak overlooking the adepti dwellings.

markers.name: Geoculus - Wangshu Inn Roof
markers.description: At the very top finial beam of Wangshu Inn roof.

markers.name: Geoculus - Dihua Marsh Bamboo Stilt
markers.description: Floating above fisherman raft near the river reeds.

markers.name: Geoculus - Qingce Village Terraced Falls
markers.description: Hovering over the wooden aqueduct waterfall drop.

markers.name: Geoculus - Guyun Stone Forest Arch
markers.description: Underneath the broken stone arch above the Ruin Guard circle.

markers.name: Geoculus - Mt. Tianheng Cavern Opening
markers.description: At the cliffside opening overlooking Liyue Harbor docks.

markers.name: Luxurious Chest - Qingyun Peak Cloud Floating Island
markers.description: Unlocked after rotating the three mountain bird statues to Qingyun Peak.

markers.name: Luxurious Chest - Guyun Ruin Guard Shipwreck
markers.description: Aboard the pirate Alcor vessel crow's nest or island wreckage.

markers.name: Precious Chest - Luhua Pool Pressure Plate Puzzle
markers.description: Activate the Geo totems in order around the painter statue pond.

markers.name: Exquisite Chest - Guili Plains Ruin Camp
markers.description: Protected by treasure hoarders guarding ancient stone pillar.

markers.name: Common Chest - Liyue Harbor Wooden Wharf
markers.description: Hidden behind fish crates under the wharf stairway.

markers.name: Shrine of Depths - Minlin Solitary Peak
markers.description: On isolated stone spire southwest of Mt. Aocang lake.

markers.name: Seelie - Dihua Marsh Northern Island
markers.description: Guides player across the shallow sandbar to a chest.

markers.name: Cor Lapis - Mt. Hulao Amber Ridge
markers.description: Rich mineral cluster surrounding amber crystal traps.

markers.name: Cor Lapis - Cuijue Slope Valley
markers.description: Along the red terracotta cliff face near 9 pillars ruins.

markers.name: Waypoint - Main Mining Area Incline
markers.description: Upper scaffolding overlook inside the Chasm underground mine.

markers.name: Waypoint - Nameless Ruins Upside-Down City
markers.description: Opposite the inverted celestial teleporter inside ancient ruins.

markers.name: Luxurious Chest - Inverted Castle Chamber
markers.description: At the highest broken ceiling ledge of the inverted ruins.

markers.name: Precious Chest - Underground Waterway Waterfall
markers.description: Behind the subterranean waterfall, requires Geo construct jump.

markers.name: Exquisite Chest - Stony Halls Lumenspar Cage
markers.description: Dispel the level 6 oozing conduit to reveal the chest.

markers.name: Seelie - Underground Canal Luminescent Seelie
markers.description: Floating above dark mud; guide along the subterranean canal.

markers.name: Waypoint - Dadaupa Gorge Ridge
markers.description: On cliff edge overlooking the sword cemetery in Dadaupa Gorge.

markers.name: Precious Chest - Dadaupa Sword Cemetery Seal
markers.description: Requires unlocking three elemental monuments in surrounding tribes.

markers.name: Precious Chest - Dunyu Ruins Pool Drainage
markers.description: Drain Dunyu pool and guide 3 seelies to disable the barrier.

markers.name: Shrine of Depths - Guyun Stone Forest Ridge
markers.description: On the furthest southern solitary islet of Guyun archipelago.

markers.name: Seelie - Wolvendom Hollow Ridge
markers.description: Hovering near electro crystals above the trial arena pathway.

markers.name: Cor Lapis - Mt. Aocang Underground Chasm Cave
markers.description: Underground cavern beneath the mountain lake with Geo Geovishap.
